source: RFC 0007 §10.1 (usability triage for beta.5, UC-14; its review)
statement: The diff of two revisions names, in sections, every member of a document besides its header (kind, owner, revision, publishedAt, provenance) and the entries it lists by id (policies, bindings, roles), each compared by its whole content: catalog, boundary, limits, attributes, rateLimits, in that order. A member added to the document format is placed in one of the three or a test fails, so no difference in it diffs as nothing.
guards: control:DiffMembersTest#every member of a document is a header, an entry list or a section of the diff
control:DiffMembersTest#the diff places no member a document does not have
control:DiffAndAccessReviewTest#the sections that differ are each named, in the format's order
